name: Langoona
description: Langoona was a remote world located in the Bootana Hutta region of Hutt Space. Centuries ago, it was the homeworld of a once-favored slave species of the Hutts. However, after a failed rebellion, their masters drove them to the brink of extinction, preserving them only as targets for sadistic safaris.
